'''Yihu''' is a waiter at [[Panhua Restaurant]] who enjoys gossips and telling jokes in {{Rubi|Guankou|stand-up show}} style. Later, it's revealed he's an undercover intel for the [[Public Security Bureau]].

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|Yihu}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Yihu}}

==Idle==
:{{DIcon}} Ready to order? We've got Chili Oil Chicken, Pulled Chicken, Poached Chicken...
:{{DIcon}} Alright. If you need help with anything, just holler. I'm always at your service!
:{{DIcon}} Here's your meal. Enjoy!

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Yihu:''' Hehe, I'll let you in on a little secret. You can overhear all kinds of things here.
:'''Yihu:''' From big news to juicy gossip, just hang around long enough and you'll know everything there is to know about Jinzhou!
:'''Yihu:''' Don't believe me? I myself have a whole list of stories I could share with you.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not interested.
::'''Yihu:''' Oh! Alright, alright, it's not urgent. We can chat when you're interested.
:{{DIcon}} Can you describe what happened?
::'''Yihu:''' So much is happening. Look at [[Liuxian Teahouse]], it's bustling. So many people come here to drink tea and chat.
::'''Yihu:''' But I heard the teahouse is secretly owned by some big shot who just so happens to also be a great fighter, and kind of a gentleman at that.
::'''Yihu:''' Alright, that's it for now. If you have any interesting stories, feel free to share. We love hearing them! I'll leave you to it.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;(During the evening)
:'''Yihu:''' I tell you, nighttime is when it really gets lively. Everyone's out and about, chatting and relaxing.
:'''Yihu:''' You might run into folks from all walks of life, even some big shots you wouldn't see during the day.
:'''Yihu:''' If you're hoping to bump into someone, don't miss out on the nightlife here!
----
;(Past 2AM behind Panhua's Restaurant)
:'''Yihu:''' Huh? Wh-what are you doing here in the middle of the night...?
:{{DIcon}} Well, you're here too.
:'''Yihu:''' I-I'm here to prepare a birthday meal for a customer who's celebrating tomorrow!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
*Guankou, also known as called talk strings or cross talk, refers to an oral technique used in Xiangsheng performances where two performers exchange dialog with each other in a comedic matter.
